Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer with 5+ years of experience in building scalable AI/ML systems, designing high‑performance architectures, and implementing modern Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong system design knowledge, deep ML/DL fundamentals, and hands‑on expertise with LLMs, RAG architectures, and agentic frameworks. AI/ML

  • Build, train, and deploy ML/DL models
  • Create full RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and LLM apps
  • Fine‑tune, optimize, and evaluate LLMs

System Design & Architecture

  • Design scalable AI solutions and ML microservices
  • Build fast, reliable systems for LLM/RAG
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate AI into products

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and automated retraining

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Own AI/ML projects and solve complex problems
  • Conduct code reviews and enforce standards
  • Work with backend, data, DevOps, and product teams
  • Translate business needs into AI solutions
summary: Senior AI/ML Engineer leads design, development, and deployment of scalable generative AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and MLOps.

Job Summary

Company: Trainonex Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Position: Academic Counsellor

Trainonex Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a proactive, articulate, and results‑oriented Academic Counsellor to join our team. The ideal candidate will understand prospective students' academic and career aspirations, provide guidance on educational programs, explain course details, and assist candidates throughout the enrolment process. The role requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a student‑focused approach, strong follow‑up capabilities, and the ability to achieve enrolment targets while maintaining professional standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Student Counselling: Interact with prospective students to understand their educational backgrounds, career goals, interests, and learning requirements.
  • Course Guidance: Provide accurate information on available courses, program structures, eligibility criteria, duration, fees, and career opportunities.
  • Lead Management: Handle incoming enquiries, follow up with prospective students, and maintain consistent communication to convert enquiries into enrolments.
  • Enrolment Support: Guide students through application, registration, documentation, and admission processes.
  • Outbound Communication: Contact prospective students via telephone calls, emails, messaging platforms, and other approved channels.
  • Needs Assessment: Identify students' requirements and recommend suitable educational programs based on interests, qualifications, and career objectives.
  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain positive relationships with students and parents, providing timely assistance and addressing queries professionally.
  • Target Achievement: Work towards achieving assigned counselling, follow‑up, admission, and enrolment targets.
  • Lead Tracking & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of enquiries, follow‑ups, counselling sessions, admission status, and enrolment conversions using company systems.
  • Query Resolution: Address student enquiries and concerns professionally, escalating complex issues when necessary.
  • Coordination: Collaborate with admissions, marketing, and other teams to ensure a smooth student acquisition process.
  • Follow‑up Management: Conduct timely follow‑ups with interested candidates and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective students.
  • Market Awareness: Stay informed about relevant educational programs, industry trends, and career opportunities to provide meaningful guidance.
  • Professional Standards: Maintain confidentiality of student information and adhere to company policies, communication standards, and ethical counselling practices.

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: ₹18,000 per month
summary: Academic Counsellor role guiding prospective students through course selection and enrolment, driving targets with strong communication and relationship skills.
